cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys, io
sys.path.insert(0,'deps')
import zstandard as zstd
c=zstd.ZstdCompressor()
data=b'hello world\n'*10
f1=c.compress(data)
c2=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True)
f2=c2.compress(data)
# skippable frame
skip=b'\x50\x2a\x4d\x18'+ (4).to_bytes(4,'little') + b'test'
print('concat ok:', zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(f1+f2), read_across_frames=True).read()==data+data)
print('skip ok:', zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(skip+f1), read_across_frames=True).read()==data)
try:
    r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(f1[:-2]), read_across_frames=True).read()
    print('truncated ->', r)
except Exception as e: print('truncated err', type(e).__name__, e)
bad=bytearray(f2); bad[5]^=1
try:
    r=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(bytes(bad)), read_across_frames=True).read()
    print('corrupt ->', r)
except Exception as e: print('corrupt err', type(e).__name__, e)
print(zstd.get_frame_parameters(f1))
"
